rules.text: A rider is charged the fare quoted at booking unless the trip materially deviates from the quoted trip.
Surge pricing applied at booking is valid for the whole trip and is not itself grounds for a refund.
A promotion applied at booking must be honoured.
Goodwill compensation up to SGD 15.00 may be offered where a rider experienced a real service failure that policy does not otherwise remedy.
The planned route is the route offered at booking. Actual distance is measured from device telemetry.
A deviation up to 15% of planned distance is within normal operating tolerance.
A deviation above 15% requires justification.
A stop not requested by the rider and longer than 4 minutes is an unexplained stop.
Trip duration above 130% of the estimate, where distance is within tolerance, is attributable to traffic and is not refundable on its own.
A cancellation fee is valid only where the driver arrived, waited 5 minutes after arrival, and attempted contact at least once.
Arrival means telemetry places the driver within 100 m of the pickup point.
Contact attempt means a call or chat message recorded in the platform.
Where the driver waited less than 5 minutes or made no recorded contact attempt, the fee is invalid.
Where the rider cancelled before the driver was assigned, no fee applies.
A cleaning fee requires evidence that the mess occurred during the trip and was caused by the rider.
Photographic evidence must be timestamped within 2 hours of trip end.
Any reported safety incident is high impact and is escalated to human review regardless of confidence.
Threatening or abusive language in the chat log is a safety signal.
System records are verified evidence. Party statements outside the platform are unverified.
Where verified and unverified evidence conflict, verified evidence prevails.
Missing, contradictory, or internally inconsistent evidence escalates.
Prior dispute history informs fraud assessment and may not by itself decide a case.
Prior rulings are advisory and non-binding.
Escalate when Judge confidence is below 0.70.
Escalate when the case is materially uncertain, contradictory, insufficient, or inaccurate.
Escalate when the case is high impact.
Escalate when the remedy the evidence supports exceeds automated ruling caps.
An escalated case carries a complete human-review summary.
